title: 20-seed robustness extension for latent operator induction
question: Is the C19 latent-operator selection behavior robust across a larger pre-specified seed panel, and what is the observed operator-confusion pattern?
relation_to_prior: Post-C19 robustness extension. It cannot replace, upgrade, or rewrite the original five-seed C19 decision.
rules: No change to the C19 contract, outcome, or threshold is permitted from this extension.
The frozen C19 benchmark generator blob must match before training.
Held-out compositions remain exactly the C19 12-composition set.
Evaluation is generated after training from the registered per-seed evaluation RNG namespace.
Training/evaluation semantic overlap must be zero.
Operator confusion is computed from argmax operator prediction before oracle override.
Training operator counts are recorded from the actual sampled combo2 stream.
No hyperparameter, checkpoint, seed, or metric selection is permitted.
Results are descriptive robustness evidence only and cannot overturn C19.

decision_rule.condition: all integrity gates pass; 20-seed robustness panel is complete with zero train/evaluation overlap and valid fingerprints
decision_rule.licenses: descriptive robustness evidence about C19's latent-operator behavior across the registered seed panel
decision_rule.does_not_license: replacement or upgrade of C19; operator synthesis outside the fixed primitive library; semantic addressing; real-world multimodal competence

decision_rule.condition: integrity gates pass but the 20-seed panel shows instability or fails to support the planned robustness interpretation
decision_rule.licenses: the instability pattern is measured evidence and C19 remains at its original bounded status
decision_rule.does_not_license: intrinsic difficulty of any Boolean operator; architecture impossibility; post-hoc threshold changes

decision_rule.condition: any frozen-lineage, leakage, or artifact gate fails
decision_rule.does_not_license: any scientific conclusion from the extension

hypothesis: The larger seed panel will quantify whether C19's observed operator-selection instability is recurrent and identify any operator-specific confusion pattern without changing the original C19 decision.

arms.name: normal_latent_operator_020seed
arms.intervention: same latent-operator model and training protocol as C19, repeated for the 20 registered seeds

arms.name: oracle_operator_diagnostic
arms.intervention: same trained model with hidden operator supplied only for q2 diagnostic scoring

held_constant: C19 benchmark generator, held-out 12-composition set, and fixed Boolean primitive execution library
five original C19 training hyperparameters: 300 steps, batch size 96, hidden dimension 64, residual-linear state write, AdamW learning rate 0.002 and weight decay 0.0001
explicit entity addressing and collision-free payload-only multimodal encoders
operator induction remains trained only through q2 task loss; no operator-ID auxiliary target
no post-run model, checkpoint, seed, hyperparameter, or metric selection
C19's original five-seed result, threshold, and claim status are not altered by this extension
